prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Korean woman — the personification of the city of Daejeon — one woman who IS Daejeon as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER

Face — her own: a soft, gentle warmth; fair skin; oval face; eyes of natural size — smooth monolid eyes of natural size, level outer eye corners; full brows set slightly low over the eyes; a nose with a gentle aquiline curve; softly full, heart-shaped lips of natural size; storm-grey eyes; a small beauty mark under one eye.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; long wavy hair with curtain bangs; clear rain-blue hair.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: grand, opulent dress of a mythic court cut to the outfit silhouette below — rich silk brocade dense with gold-thread embroidery, gilded filigree and jewel settings, enchanted jewelry with a soft magical glow; the city's symbol worked into the embroidery and jewels.
City motif: a misty grey-blue silk over-robe embroidered in gold thread with a patchwork of ripe golden fields like a great plain seen from above, three silver-thread rivers winding across it and joining into one at her waist; a long silver hairpin in her long wavy hair from which strings of crystal raindrops fall like a soft shower.
World marks on her: layered gold-thread embroidery; a jeweled hair ornament; flowing silk ribbons trailing in the air; heraldic emblems worked in gold; glowing enchanted jewelry; heavy silk brocade; gilded filigree; a jeweled pendant with silk tassels at her waist; banners and royal regalia; a shimmer of magical light.
Silhouette: a high-collared, many-layered gown with long trailing sleeves sweeping to the floor and a slender circlet — a long, serene moon-priestess silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: golden-field ochre, clear sky blue, pale granite white — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a slender silver staff crowned with a small raincloud of clear crystal that lets fall a fine thread of glittering rain; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, and a high slit or a short hem showing the thigh; the ornaments stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a grand capital of a myth-world in a vast round valley ringed by blue mountains, just after rain on a golden evening: an endless plain of golden fields where three silver rivers wind together, willow-lined stone bridges arching over each; palaces and scholars' halls of pale granite and dark pine with gently upswept grey-tiled eaves, their tall lattice windows glowing with lamplight; on the peak of the eastern mountain an old stone fortress wrapped in rain clouds, silver rain still falling from it in soft veils over the far fields; a double rainbow over the plain, rain-lanterns floating above the wet roads and the golden fields shining wet in the low sun.
This card: on the old stone fortress wall on the cloud-wrapped peak of the eastern mountain, rain clouds swirling around her and veils of silver rain falling from the mountain over the golden plain below.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
